CHIEF_D1_001.speaker: Village Chief
CHIEF_D1_001.text: Oh, hello! You must be the farmer from the house west of the village. Welcome! I am the village chief.

CHIEF_D1_002.speaker: Village Chief
CHIEF_D1_002.text: Our village may be small, but everyone here looks out for one another. This square is where we meet, share news, and celebrate together.

PLAYER_CHIEF_D1_001.speaker: {player}
PLAYER_CHIEF_D1_001.text: It seems like a nice place. Could you show me where everything is?

CHIEF_D1_003.speaker: Village Chief
CHIEF_D1_003.text: Of course! The merchant runs the shop near the square. You can buy seeds and supplies there, and sell the crops you grow.

CHIEF_D1_004.speaker: Village Chief
CHIEF_D1_004.text: You will also find an inventor working in a workshop nearby. Their machines might help you improve your farm, once you get to know each other.

CHIEF_D1_005.speaker: Village Chief
CHIEF_D1_005.text: The path to the west takes you back to your farm. Head farther west from there and you will reach the beach. It is a peaceful spot to explore.

PLAYER_CHIEF_D1_002.speaker: {player}
PLAYER_CHIEF_D1_002.text: I received a notice about the city taking our land. Is everyone here affected?

CHIEF_D1_006.speaker: Village Chief
CHIEF_D1_006.text: Yes. The city expansion plan worries all of us. Families have built their lives here for generations, and we do not want to lose this place.

CHIEF_D1_007.speaker: Village Chief
CHIEF_D1_007.text: For now, learn the village, meet your neighbors, and get your farm running. A strong community will matter in the days ahead.

PLAYER_CHIEF_D1_003.speaker: {player}
PLAYER_CHIEF_D1_003.text: Thank you. I will introduce myself to the merchant and the inventor, and do what I can to help.

CHIEF_D1_008.speaker: Village Chief
CHIEF_D1_008.text: You are always welcome here. Check the notice board in the square for village news. Good luck with your first day!
